issues.on_page: Keno Fund column, Local Receipts: Other 19,134.57
issues.issue: This is the Keno Fund's only receipt and is very likely keno/lottery proceeds. CLAUDE.md's Waverly ruling treats lottery-fund gross keno receipts as keno/lottery. It is kept in other only because the row label is the generic 'Local Receipts: Other'. It is also inside receipts[9] (30,327.85).
The utility funds' only receipt line is likely utility/refuse charges (refuse would be Utility Charges), but the page doesn't say so (context label). The context check should decide it.
